description: Complete Box.com integration: OAuth flow testing, document browser UI, Box MCP server setup, and BOM sync validation. Builds on existing OAuth endpoints, Box API client, and BOM sync service.

userStories.title: Validate Box Developer App configuration
userStories.description: Verify the Box Developer Console has the correct redirect URI (http://localhost:5176/api/box/callback), proper scopes (read/write files and folders), and the app is approved. Ensure .env has correct credentials. Test that the OAuth redirect to Box.com works without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Box Developer Console redirect URI matches BOX_REDIRECT_URI in .env
App has necessary Box API scopes enabled
Navigating to /api/box/auth redirects to Box.com login
No errors in server console during redirect
userStories.notes: FIRST TASK - all other tasks depend on this. Check Box Developer Console at https://app.box.com/developers/console. Ensure the redirect URI exactly matches the .env value.

userStories.title: Create 'Inventory & Materials' folder in Box
userStories.description: Ensure the target folder 'Inventory & Materials' exists in the Box.com account. Create a test 'Live Equipment Overview' Excel file inside it with sample BOM columns (Part Number, Name, Description, Category, Manufacturer, Unit Cost, Quantity, Unit of Measure).
acceptanceCriteria: Folder 'Inventory & Materials' exists in Box.com root
File 'Live Equipment Overview' exists inside the folder
Excel file has correct column headers for BOM parsing
At least 3 sample BOM rows with realistic test data
userStories.notes: This is a Box.com setup task, no code changes. Can be done in parallel with BOX-001.

userStories.title: Test full OAuth flow end-to-end
userStories.description: With BOX-001 and BOX-002 complete, test the full OAuth flow: click Connect on settings page -> Box login -> authorize app -> callback stores tokens -> settings shows connected status with folder/file IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page loads at /spu/bom/settings without errors
Clicking 'Connect to Box.com' redirects to Box OAuth
After authorizing, callback redirects to settings with ?connected=true
Settings page shows green 'Connected' status
Folder ID and File ID are displayed on settings page
box_integration table has valid tokens
userStories.notes: Depends on BOX-001 and BOX-002. This is a testing/validation task.

userStories.title: Test BOM sync from Box.com
userStories.description: With Box connected (BOX-003), test the 'Sync Now' button on settings page. Verify it downloads the Excel file from Box, parses it, and creates bom_item records in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Sync Now' triggers sync without errors
Sync status shows 'Success' after completion
bom_item table has records matching Excel file data
bom_item_version table has 'create' entries for new items
Subsequent syncs show 'update' or no changes as appropriate
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
userStories.notes: Depends on BOX-003. May require fixes to bom-parser.ts if Excel format doesn't match expectations.

userStories.title: Build Box.com document browser page
userStories.description: Create a new page at /spu/documents/box that displays the contents of the 'Inventory & Materials' folder from Box.com. Show files and subfolders in a list/grid with file names, sizes, and types. Allow navigating into subfolders.
acceptanceCriteria: New route at /spu/documents/box with layout integration
Lists files and folders from 'Inventory & Materials'
Shows file name, type icon, and size for each item
Clicking a subfolder navigates into it with breadcrumbs
Back navigation works correctly
Shows loading state while fetching
Shows error state if Box not connected
Uses TRON-themed UI components
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
userStories.notes: Depends on BOX-003. Uses listFolderContents() from box client. Requires box:read permission.

userStories.title: Add file preview/download from Box browser
userStories.description: Extend the Box document browser (BOX-005) to support file preview and download. For Excel/CSV files show a table preview. For other files provide a download link. Use the existing downloadFile() from the box client.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a file opens a detail view or modal
Excel files show first 20 rows in a table preview
Download button works for all file types
API endpoint for file download with access validation
Proper error handling for failed downloads
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
userStories.notes: Depends on BOX-005. The download endpoint must validate file access using validateFileAccess().

userStories.title: Add file upload to Box from webapp
userStories.description: Add file upload capability to the Box document browser. Users can upload files to the current folder (within 'Inventory & Materials' boundary). Use the existing uploadFile() from the box client.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload button visible in Box browser when viewing a folder
File picker allows selecting files from local machine
Upload progress indicator shown during upload
Success message after upload completes
Uploaded file appears in folder listing
Access validation enforced (only within Inventory & Materials)
API endpoint for file upload with proper validation
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
userStories.notes: Depends on BOX-005. Uses uploadFile() and createSubfolder() from box client.

userStories.title: Add Box connection status to main nav
userStories.description: Add a Box.com connection indicator to the SPU layout sidebar/nav. Show a small icon indicating connected/disconnected status. Link to Box settings page.
acceptanceCriteria: Box status indicator visible in SPU layout nav
Green dot when connected, gray when disconnected
Clicking indicator navigates to /spu/bom/settings
Status loads without blocking page render
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
userStories.notes: Independent of BOX-005/006/007. Only needs box_integration table query. Add isBoxConnected to layout data.

userStories.title: Setup Box MCP server for AI-assisted content management
userStories.description: Clone and configure the box-community/mcp-server-box for local development. Set up the MCP server with the project's Box OAuth credentials so Claude can interact with Box content directly through MCP tools.
acceptanceCriteria: mcp-server-box cloned and dependencies installed
MCP server .env configured with Box credentials
MCP server starts successfully in STDIO mode
Claude Desktop or Claude Code config updated to use the MCP server
Basic test: can list files via MCP tool
Documentation added to AGENTS.md for MCP server usage
userStories.notes: Independent task - can run in parallel with BOX-003 through BOX-008. Requires Python and uv package manager. Does not modify webapp code except AGENTS.md documentation.

userStories.title: Add token refresh monitoring and auto-reconnect
userStories.description: Add a server-side check that runs on settings page load to verify the Box token is still valid by calling the Box.com /users/me endpoint. If the token refresh fails, update status to 'disconnected' and show a reconnect prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page load verifies token validity with Box API
If token is expired and refresh fails, status updates to 'disconnected'
UI shows 'Token expired - please reconnect' message
Reconnect button visible when token is invalid
Audit log entry for token expiry events
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
userStories.notes: Depends on BOX-003. Uses the /users/me endpoint from BOX_API.userInfo to validate tokens.
